# TakeMockTest

> TakeMockTest is a free, no-login mock-test platform for Indian competitive exam aspirants. It offers syllabus-checked practice tests with instant scoring, negative marking, section-wise and topic-wise result analysis, and a growing catalog of ~180 Indian competitive exams (government jobs, engineering, medical, banking, defence, teaching, and more).

Every checked question includes a source record (official notification/syllabus reference, URL, and the date it was verified) — no fabricated or "leaked paper" claims. Results and progress are stored only on the visitor's own device (localStorage); there is no account system and no server-side tracking of attempts.

## Mock tests with live, syllabus-checked content

- [SSC CGL](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-cgl/mock-test): Tier 1 (3 full mocks, sectional tests, plus quick timed tests, difficulty-tiered practice, and topic drills — 45 tests total) and Tier 2 Paper 1 Objective (3 full mocks + sectional tests)
- [SSC CHSL](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-chsl/mock-test): Tier 1 (2 full mocks + 8 sectional tests, Test 2 added 22 August 2026), single 60-minute combined timer, qualifying stage only
- [IBPS PO](https://takemocktest.com/in/ibps-po/mock-test): Prelims (2 full mocks + 6 sectional tests, Test 2 added 22 August 2026, plus 3 quick tests of 12/18/24 questions added 26 August 2026) and Mains (2 full mocks + 8 sectional tests, Test 2 added 23 August 2026, each full mock covering the 170 objective questions; the Descriptive Paper is excluded as it is not multiple-choice)
- [IBPS Clerk](https://takemocktest.com/in/ibps-clerk/mock-test): Prelims (2 full mocks + 6 sectional tests, Test 2 added 22 August 2026), 20-minute sectional timers, qualifying stage only, Mains marks decide the final merit list. Mains added 26 August 2026: 1 full mock + 3 sectionals covering Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude (50Q), Quantitative Aptitude (40Q), and English Language (40Q), flat 1 mark per correct answer; General/Financial Awareness is not yet covered, and the exact official per-section split for the 2026-revised pattern could not be independently confirmed (review-pending)
- [RRB NTPC](https://takemocktest.com/in/rrb-ntpc/mock-test): CBT 1 (2 full mocks + 6 sectional tests, Test 2 added 22 August 2026), single 90-minute combined timer, qualifying stage only
- [RRB Group D](https://takemocktest.com/in/rrb-group-d/mock-test): CBT (2 full mocks + 8 sectional tests, Test 2 added 22 August 2026), single 90-minute combined timer, followed by a non-written Physical Efficiency Test
- [SBI PO](https://takemocktest.com/in/sbi-po/mock-test): Prelims (2 full mocks + 6 sectional tests, Test 2 added 22 August 2026), 20-minute sectional timers, qualifying stage only, Mains marks decide the final merit list. Mains added 26 August 2026: 1 full mock + 3 sectionals covering Reasoning & Computer Aptitude (40Q/60 marks/50 min), Data Analysis and Interpretation (30Q/60 marks/45 min), and English Language (40Q/20 marks/40 min); General/Economy/Banking Awareness and the Descriptive Test are not yet covered
- [RBI Assistant](https://takemocktest.com/in/rbi-assistant/mock-test): Prelims (2 full mocks + 6 sectional tests, Test 2 added 22 August 2026), 20-minute sectional timers, qualifying stage only, Mains marks decide the final merit list
- [SSC MTS & Havaldar](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-mts/mock-test): CBT (2 full mocks + 8 sectional tests + 2 quick timed tests, Test 2 added 22 August 2026), two-session format — no negative marking in Session 1 (Numerical/Reasoning), 1 mark deducted per wrong answer in Session 2 (General Awareness/English)
- [IBPS RRB Office Assistant](https://takemocktest.com/in/ibps-rrb-office-assistant/mock-test): Prelims (2 full mocks + 4 sectional tests + 2 quick timed tests, Test 2 added 22 August 2026), single 45-minute combined timer (no sectional lock), qualifying stage only — Mains marks decide the final merit list
- [SSC GD Constable](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-gd-constable/mock-test): CBE (2 full mocks + 8 sectional tests + 2 quick timed tests, Test 2 added 22 August 2026), single 60-minute combined timer, Matriculation-level questions, followed by a non-written PET/PST, medical exam, and document verification
- [IBPS RRB Officer Scale I](https://takemocktest.com/in/ibps-rrb-officer-scale-1/mock-test): Prelims (2 full mocks + 4 sectional tests + 2 quick timed tests, Test 2 added 22 August 2026), single 45-minute combined timer (no sectional lock), qualifying stage only — graduate-entry officer-level difficulty, higher than the IBPS RRB Office Assistant mock on this site
- [SBI Clerk](https://takemocktest.com/in/sbi-clerk/mock-test): Prelims (2 full mocks + 6 sectional tests + 2 quick timed tests, Test 2 added 22 August 2026), 3 separately-timed 20-minute sections (English Language, Numerical Ability, Reasoning Ability), sectional lock, not a combined timer, qualifying stage only, Mains marks decide the final merit list
- [RRB Junior Engineer / DMS / CMA](https://takemocktest.com/in/rrb-je/mock-test): CBT 1 (2 full mocks + 8 sectional tests, Test 2 added 22 August 2026), single 90-minute combined timer, common screening stage only — branch-specific CBT 2 decides the final merit list
- [UPSC Civil Services Preliminary](https://takemocktest.com/in/upsc-cse/mock-test): GS Paper I (1 full mock + 7 sectional tests, 100Q/200 marks/120 min) and CSAT Paper II (1 full mock + 6 sectional tests, 80Q/200 marks/120 min, qualifying only at 33%) — both single-timer papers with no sectional lock
- [RPF Constable](https://takemocktest.com/in/rpf-constable/mock-test): CBT (2 full mocks + 6 sectional tests, 120Q/120 marks/90 min, Test 2 added 22 August 2026), single combined timer, 1/3 negative marking, followed by a non-written PET/PMT, document verification, and medical examination
- [SSC CPO](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-cpo/mock-test): Paper 1 (2 full mocks + 8 sectional tests, 200Q/200 marks/120 min, Test 2 added 23 August 2026), sectional lock — each of the four sections has its own separately timed 30-minute window, 1/4 negative marking, followed by PST/PET, Paper 2 (English), and a medical examination
- [IBPS SO](https://takemocktest.com/in/ibps-so/mock-test): Prelims (2 full mocks + 6 sectional tests, 150Q/125 marks/120 min, Test 2 added 23 August 2026) for IT Officer, Agriculture Field Officer, HR/Personnel Officer, and Marketing Officer (Scale I) — sectional lock with three separately timed 40-minute sections; English Language questions carry 0.5 marks each while Reasoning and Quantitative Aptitude carry 1 mark each; qualifying stage only, Mains (Professional Knowledge) marks decide the final merit list
- [RBI Grade B](https://takemocktest.com/in/rbi-grade-b/mock-test): Phase I (2 full mocks + 8 sectional tests, Test 2 added 23 August 2026, 200Q/200 marks/120 min) for the General cadre — sectional lock with four separately timed windows (25/25/25/45 min), 1/4 negative marking; qualifying stage only, Phase II (Economic and Social Issues, English Writing Skills, Finance and Management) and interview decide the final merit list
- [NABARD Grade A](https://takemocktest.com/in/nabard-grade-a/mock-test): Phase I (2 full mocks + 16 sectional tests, Test 2 added 24 August 2026, 200Q/200 marks/120 min) for the RDBS (General) cadre — single composite 120-minute timer across all eight sections, no sectional lock, 1/4 negative marking; Reasoning, English Language, Computer Knowledge, Quantitative Aptitude, and Decision Making are qualifying only, while General Awareness, Economic and Social Issues, and Agriculture and Rural Development form the merit section that decides Phase II (Mains) shortlisting
- [SEBI Grade A](https://takemocktest.com/in/sebi-grade-a/mock-test): Phase I for the General stream, modelled as two separately-timed papers — Paper 1 (2 full mocks + 8 sectional tests, Test 2 added 24 August 2026, 80Q/100 marks/60 min: General Awareness, English Language, Quantitative Aptitude, Test of Reasoning) and Paper 2 (2 full mocks + 14 sectional tests, Test 2 added 24 August 2026, 50Q/100 marks/40 min: Commerce, Accountancy, Management, Finance, Costing, Companies Act, Economics) — each paper uses its own composite timer with no sectional lock, 1/4 negative marking (1.25 marks/question in Paper 1, 2 marks/question in Paper 2)
- [SIDBI Grade A & B](https://takemocktest.com/in/sidbi-grade-a-b/mock-test): Phase I for the General stream (2 full mocks + 14 sectional tests, Test 2 added 24 August 2026, 200Q/200 marks/120 min) — single composite 120-minute timer across all seven sections, no sectional lock, 1/4 negative marking; English Language, Reasoning Aptitude, Quantitative Aptitude, and Computer Knowledge are qualifying only, while General Awareness, MSMEs Policy/Finance/Management, and the Stream Specific Test form the 100-mark merit section that decides Phase II shortlisting
- [LIC AAO](https://takemocktest.com/in/lic-aao/mock-test): Prelims (2 full mocks + 6 sectional tests, Test 2 added 22 August 2026, 100Q/100 marks/60 min) — sectional lock with three separately timed 20-minute windows (Reasoning Ability, Quantitative Aptitude, English Language), zero negative marking; English Language is scored but qualifying only, so only the 70 marks from Reasoning Ability and Quantitative Aptitude decide who advances to Mains
- [NIACL AO](https://takemocktest.com/in/niacl-ao/mock-test): Prelims (2 full mocks + 6 sectional tests, Test 2 added 22 August 2026, 100Q/100 marks/60 min) and Mains (2 full mocks + 8 sectional tests, Test 2 added 23 August 2026, 200Q/200 marks/150 min) for the Administrative Officer (Generalist) role — both stages use sectional lock, 1/4 negative marking; Prelims is qualifying only and used to shortlist for Mains, while Mains' Descriptive Test (Letter Writing and Essay) is excluded as it is not multiple-choice; final selection is decided by the Mains objective score plus interview
- [RRB ALP](https://takemocktest.com/in/rrb-alp/mock-test): CBT 1 (2 full mocks + 8 sectional tests, Test 2 added 23 August 2026, 75Q/75 marks/60 min, screening only) and CBT 2 Part A (2 full mocks + 6 sectional tests, Test 2 added 23 August 2026, 100Q/100 marks/90 min) for Assistant Loco Pilot — both stages use a single composite timer per stage (no sectional lock), 1/3 negative marking; CBT 2 Part B (trade-specific, varies by candidate) and the Computer Based Aptitude Test (a psychometric battery) are excluded since they cannot be modeled as a common-syllabus MCQ mock; final merit is 70% Part A of CBT 2 plus 30% CBAT score
- [RRB Technician](https://takemocktest.com/in/rrb-technician/mock-test): Grade I Signal CBT (2 full mocks + 10 sectional tests, Test 2 added 23 August 2026, 100Q/100 marks/90 min) and Grade III CBT (2 full mocks + 8 sectional tests, Test 2 added 23 August 2026, 100Q/100 marks/90 min) — each pay level has a single CBT that directly decides shortlisting for Document Verification (no second-stage CBT, no skill test), single composite timer per stage (no sectional lock), 1/3 negative marking
- [RRB Paramedical Categories](https://takemocktest.com/in/rrb-paramedical/mock-test): single CBT (3 sectional tests only, no full mock), covering General Awareness (10Q), General Arithmetic and General Intelligence and Reasoning (10Q, combined into one section as per the official pattern), and General Science (10Q). Professional Ability, 70 of the 100 questions, is excluded: it varies by post (Staff Nurse, Pharmacist, Laboratory Assistant, Radiographer, ECG Technician, and others), so there is no single common syllabus that would be accurate for every candidate. This is the only exam on this site without a full-length mock, and the exclusion is stated on the exam page. Single CBT directly decides Document Verification shortlisting; 1/3 negative marking
- [RPF Sub-Inspector](https://takemocktest.com/in/rpf-si/mock-test): CBT (2 full mocks + 6 sectional tests, 120Q/120 marks/90 min, Test 2 added 23 August 2026), single composite timer (no sectional lock), 1/3 negative marking, graduation-level questions. Same section structure as RPF Constable on this site (Arithmetic, General Intelligence and Reasoning, General Awareness) but a distinct question bank, since RPF SI is set at graduation level while RPF Constable is not. Minimum pass percentage: UR, EWS and OBC-NCL 35%, SC and ST 30%. Single CBT directly decides shortlisting for a qualifying-only PET/PMT, followed by Document Verification
- [SSC Junior Engineer](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-je/mock-test): Paper I (2 full mocks + 4 sectional tests, 100Q/100 marks/120 min, Test 2 added 22 August 2026), single composite timer (no sectional lock), 0.25 negative marking. Paper I covers only General Intelligence and Reasoning (50Q) and General Awareness (50Q), common to every candidate regardless of engineering discipline. Paper II, the discipline-specific General Engineering paper (100Q/300 marks, varies by Civil, Electrical, or Mechanical stream), is excluded since no single question bank would suit every candidate, but note that Paper II is fully objective and multiple-choice too, not descriptive as some secondary sources describe it; both papers' normalized scores together decide the final merit list
- [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-steno/mock-test): Computer Based Examination (2 full mocks + 6 sectional tests, Test 2 added 23 August 2026, 200Q/200 marks/120 min), single composite timer (no sectional lock), 0.25 negative marking, covering General Intelligence and Reasoning (50Q), General Awareness (50Q), and English Language and Comprehension (100Q). The Stenography Skill Test (a 10-minute dictation and transcription exercise at 100 WPM for Grade C or 80 WPM for Grade D) is excluded since it is not a multiple-choice format; normalized CBT scores decide the Skill Test shortlist and final merit
- [SSC Combined Hindi Translators](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-cht/mock-test): Paper I (2 full mocks, 4 sectional tests, and 3 quick tests, Test 2 added 23 August 2026, 200Q/200 marks/120 min), separate 60-minute timers for General Hindi (100Q) and General English (100Q), with 0.25 negative marking. Paper II is a 200-mark descriptive translation and essay paper and is not modeled in the MCQ interface
- [SSC Selection Post](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-selection-post/mock-test): Phase XIV/2026 CBEs for Matriculation, Higher Secondary (10+2), and Graduation and Above posts. Each level has 2 full mocks, 8 sectional tests, and 2 quick tests (Test 2 added 23 August 2026), with 100Q/200 marks/60 min, four separately timed 15-minute parts, and 0.50 negative marking. Post-specific qualifying skill tests are not included
- [BITSAT](https://takemocktest.com/in/bitsat/mock-test): 2026 Mathematics variant, 2 Full Mocks (Test 2 added 24 August 2026), each with the standard 130 questions for 390 marks in 180 minutes under one composite timer and no sectional lock. Physics has 30 questions, Chemistry 30, English Proficiency 10, Logical Reasoning 20, and Mathematics 40; correct answers earn +3, incorrect answers deduct 1, and unattempted questions score zero. The optional 12 extra questions are not included
- [JEE Main](https://takemocktest.com/in/jee-main/mock-test): 2026 Paper 1 for B.E. and B.Tech. admission (2 full mocks, 6 sectional tests, and 2 mixed quick tests, Test 2 added 24 August 2026), 75Q/300 marks/180 min under one combined timer. Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry each contain 20 MCQs plus 5 numerical-value questions, with +4 for a correct answer and -1 for an incorrect answer in both formats
- [JEE Main Paper 2](https://takemocktest.com/in/jee-main-paper-2/mock-test): 2026 Paper 2 for B.Arch and B.Planning admission. Paper 2A B.Arch Objective Practice Test (75Q/300 marks/180 min, TakeMockTest-defined practice timer) covers Mathematics (20 MCQ + 5 numerical-value) and Aptitude Test (50 MCQ) only; the 100-mark offline Drawing Test is excluded since it needs human evaluation. Paper 2B B.Planning Full Mock (100Q/400 marks/180 min, official NTA duration) covers the complete official structure: Mathematics 25, Aptitude Test 50, Planning 25. Both use +4/-1/0 scoring with numerical answers evaluated to the nearest integer
- [NATA](https://takemocktest.com/in/nata/mock-test): 2026 Mathematics-only mock (20Q/40 marks/30 min, TakeMockTest practice timer), no negative marking, matching the official NATA scheme. The official exam is 200 marks/3 hours across an offline Drawing and Composition Test (excluded, not auto-gradable) and a computer-based Aptitude Test combining Mathematics and General Aptitude; General Aptitude is also excluded since sources describe it as a bundle of visual, spatial, and general-knowledge content with no clean published split from its reasoning portion. The official nata.in/coa.gov.in sources could not be independently accessed while researching this mock, so the pattern is marked review-pending, sourced from corroborating secondary sources rather than a directly verified primary document
- [MHT CET](https://takemocktest.com/in/mht-cet/mock-test): PCM group, 2 Full Mocks (Test 2 added 24 August 2026, 150Q/200 marks/180 min each, official 2026 CET Cell pattern) plus a Physics + Chemistry Group Practice test (100Q/100 marks/90 min) and 2 Mathematics Sectionals (50Q/100 marks/90 min each), no negative marking. Physics and Chemistry award 1 mark each, Mathematics awards 2. The official exam runs as two sequential timing groups rather than one free 180-minute timer: Physics and Chemistry share the first 90 minutes and auto-submit as a group, then Mathematics gets a separate 90 minutes with no return to the first group; the Full Mocks reproduce this exactly
- [WBJEE](https://takemocktest.com/in/wbjee/mock-test): Engineering, 2 Full Mocks (Test 2 added 24 August 2026, 155Q/200 marks/240 min working time each, official 2026 WBJEEB bulletin pattern) plus a Mathematics Paper I Practice test (75Q/100 marks/120 min) and a Physics and Chemistry Paper II Practice test (80Q/100 marks/120 min). Scoring runs three categories across every subject: Category 1 (single-correct, +1/-0.25), Category 2 (single-correct, +2/-0.5), and Category 3 (multi-select, up to +2 with no negative marking and proportional partial credit for selecting only some of the correct options). The official exam runs as two separately timed papers rather than one free 240-minute timer: Paper I (Mathematics) gets 120 minutes and auto-submits, then Paper II (Physics and Chemistry, free navigation between the two) gets a separate 120 minutes with no return to Paper I; the Full Mocks reproduce this exactly, and do not add the real exam's 1-hour inter-paper gap as working time
- [AP EAPCET](https://takemocktest.com/in/ap-eapcet/mock-test): Engineering, 2 Full Mocks (Test 2 added 24 August 2026, 160Q/160 marks, single unrestricted 180-minute timer each, official pattern), covering Mathematics (80), Physics (40), and Chemistry (40) with free navigation across all three subjects and no section locking, matching the official CBT format. Also includes 2 Mathematics Sectionals (80Q/80 marks/90 min each) and a Physics + Chemistry Sectional (80Q/80 marks/90 min), platform-defined timers since AP EAPCET does not publish separate official section timings. +1 per correct answer, no negative marking. Sourced from the AP EAPCET portal, its Engineering Instruction Booklet, its Important CBT Instructions document, and official 2026 master question papers; questions are presented in English only, while the official CBT displays them bilingually in English and Telugu
- [KCET](https://takemocktest.com/in/kcet/mock-test): Karnataka UGCET Engineering, 2 Full Mocks (Test 2 added 24 August 2026, 180Q/180 marks/240 min working time each, official 2026 KEA pattern) plus 2 standalone practice tests per subject (60Q/60 marks/80 min each), no negative marking, +1 per correct answer throughout. The official exam runs as three separately timed subject papers rather than one free 240-minute timer: Physics gets 80 minutes and auto-submits, then Chemistry gets a separate 80 minutes with no return to Physics, then Mathematics gets a final separate 80 minutes with no return to either earlier subject; the Full Mocks reproduce this exactly, and do not add the real exam's cross-day idle gaps between subject sessions as working time. The current KEA UGCET 2026 portal and its bulletin/syllabus/bell-timing documents are directly confirmed to exist and be currently published; the exact question-count, marks, duration, and scoring figures are corroborated across secondary sources rather than machine-read directly from the official bulletin
- [TG EAPCET](https://takemocktest.com/in/tg-eapcet/mock-test): Telangana Engineering, 2 Full Mocks (Test 2 added 24 August 2026, 160Q/160 marks, single unrestricted 180-minute timer each), covering Mathematics (80), Physics (40), and Chemistry (40) with free navigation across all three subjects and no section locking. Also includes 2 Mathematics Sectionals (80Q/80 marks/90 min each) and a Physics + Chemistry Sectional (80Q/80 marks/90 min), platform-defined timers since TG EAPCET does not publish separate official section timings. +1 per correct answer, no negative marking. The TG EAPCET portal, its CBT identity, its exam dates, and its published syllabus are directly confirmed; the exact question-count, marks, duration, and scoring pattern are corroborated across secondary sources rather than machine-read directly from a current official document, so this pattern is marked review-pending pending independent re-verification. Questions are presented in English only, while the official CBT offers bilingual English plus either Telugu or Urdu display
- [JEE Advanced](https://takemocktest.com/in/jee-advanced/mock-test): 2026 Paper 1 (48Q/180 marks/180 min) and Paper 2 (54Q/180 marks/180 min), each with 2 full mocks and 6 subject sectionals (Test 2 added 24 August 2026). Both papers use single-correct, multi-select with partial marking, and numerical-value formats; both official papers are compulsory
- [VITEEE](https://takemocktest.com/in/viteee/mock-test): 2026 MPCEA Mathematics stream, 2 Full Mocks (Test 2 added 24 August 2026, 125Q/500 marks/150 min each under one combined timer) plus 5 sectional tests and 2 mixed quick tests. Mathematics 40, Physics 35, Chemistry 35, Aptitude 10, English 5; +4 for a correct answer and -1 for an incorrect answer, a change from the no-negative-marking rule used in 2025. Sectional and quick-practice timers are TakeMockTest-defined, not official VITEEE sectional timings. BPCEA (Biology stream) is not covered
- [SRMJEEE](https://takemocktest.com/in/srmjeee/mock-test): 2026 PCM Mathematics route, 2 Full Mocks (Test 2 added 24 August 2026, 130Q/130 marks/150 min each under one combined timer) plus 4 sectional tests and 2 mixed quick tests. Physics 35, Chemistry 35, Mathematics 40, English & Aptitude 20; +1 for a correct answer and no negative marking. Sectional and quick-practice timers are TakeMockTest-defined, not official SRMJEEE sectional timings. The Mathematics/Biology route is not covered
- [AEEE](https://takemocktest.com/in/aeee/mock-test): 2026 B.Tech, 2 Full Mocks (Test 2 added 24 August 2026, 100Q/300 marks/150 min each under one combined timer) plus 5 sectional tests and 2 mixed quick tests. Mathematics 40, Physics 25, Chemistry 20, Quantitative Aptitude 10, English 5; +3 for a correct answer and -1 for an incorrect answer. Sectional and quick-practice timers are TakeMockTest-defined, not official AEEE sectional timings
- [MET](https://takemocktest.com/in/met/mock-test): Manipal Entrance Test 2026 B.Tech, 2 Full Mocks (Test 2 added 24 August 2026, 60Q/240 marks/120 min each under one combined timer) plus 4 sectional tests and 2 mixed quick tests. Mathematics 20, Physics 15, Chemistry 15, English 10; 45 Multiple Choice Questions score +4/-1/0 and 15 Numerical Answer Type questions score +4/0/0. Sectional and quick-practice timers are TakeMockTest-defined, not official MET sectional timings
- [COMEDK UGET](https://takemocktest.com/in/comedk-uget/mock-test): 2026 B.E./B.Tech (PCM), 2 Full Mocks (Test 2 added 24 August 2026, 180Q/180 marks/180 min each under one combined timer) plus 3 sectional tests. Physics 60, Chemistry 60, Mathematics 60; +1 for a correct answer and no negative marking. COMEDK UGET 2026's official notification and brochure do not publish a numeric session duration in readable public text, so the 180-minute Full Mock timer and 60-minute sectional timers are TakeMockTest-defined practice durations, not official COMEDK figures
- [IIIT Hyderabad UGEE](https://takemocktest.com/in/iiit-hyderabad-ugee/mock-test): 2026 Undergraduate Entrance Examination (1 full mock and 2 sectional tests), 90Q/140 marks/180 min. SUPR (Subject Proficiency Test) 40 questions in 60 minutes, scored +1/-0.25; REAP (Research Aptitude Test) 50 questions in 120 minutes, scored +2/-0.5, both officially 25% negative marking. SUPR filters candidates, then REAP ranks them for interview shortlisting; final admission is by interview only. IIIT Hyderabad's public page does not publish an exact question count or marks-per-question scale for the current cycle, so the 40/50 question split is corroborated from consistent secondary sources, not an official IIITH figure. The Full Mock uses TakeMockTest's own SUPR-then-REAP section lock; official navigation between sections was not independently verified
- [IELTS](https://takemocktest.com/in/ielts/mock-test): Reading module for both Academic (1 full mock + 3 passage sectionals) and General Training (1 full mock + 3 section sectionals), 40Q/40 marks/60 min per variant under one combined timer, no negative marking. Every question uses a multiple-choice format so it can be scored instantly; the official test also uses matching and sentence-completion formats for the same reading skills. Listening, Writing, and Speaking are not covered
- [TOEFL](https://takemocktest.com/in/toefl/mock-test): Reading module (1 full mock + 2 sectionals, 30Q/30 marks/30 min), covering the Read in Daily Life and Read an Academic Passage task types from the official 2026 adaptive Reading section. Complete the Words, a vocabulary/word-completion task worth about 60% of the official item pool, is not multiple-choice and is not covered. Listening, Speaking, and Writing are not covered
- [PTE Academic](https://takemocktest.com/in/pte/mock-test): Reading module (1 full mock + 2 sectionals, 20Q/20 marks/25 min), covering the Multiple Choice: Single Answer and Multiple Choice: Multiple Answers task types (the second uses select-all-that-apply with partial marking) from the official Reading section. Re-order Paragraphs and both Fill in the Blanks task types use drag-and-drop or dropdown formats and are not covered. Listening, Speaking, and Writing are not covered
- [OET](https://takemocktest.com/in/oet/mock-test): Reading Part C only (1 full mock + 2 sectionals, 16Q/16 marks/32 min), the official test's only 4-option multiple-choice part. Part A (20 items, typed short-answer/matching/sentence-completion) and Part B (6 items, 3-option multiple choice) are not covered, since neither matches this site's 4-option format. Listening, Writing, and Speaking are not covered. Reading is identical across all 12 OET professions
- [FRM](https://takemocktest.com/in/frm/mock-test): Part I Quantitative Analysis only (1 full mock + 2 sectionals, 20Q/20 marks/48 min), covering probability, distributions, and regression, the one FRM topic area built entirely from calculation and independently checkable without outside finance-domain knowledge. The rest of Part I (Foundations of Risk Management, Financial Markets and Products, Valuation and Risk Models) and all of Part II (Market Risk, Credit Risk, Operational Risk, Liquidity and Treasury Risk, Risk Management and Investment Management, Current Issues in Financial Markets) are not covered, since they require accurate recall of risk-management methodology and regulatory frameworks rather than calculation alone
- [NISM](https://takemocktest.com/in/nism/mock-test): Series V-A (Mutual Fund Distributors), calculation-only questions (1 full mock + 2 sectionals, 20Q/20 marks/24 min), covering NAV, returns, SIP, and compounding mathematics, independently verifiable by formula. Fund categorization rules, regulatory and compliance content, and taxation are not covered, since those change with SEBI and tax circulars and require current, accurate recall rather than calculation
- [ACET](https://takemocktest.com/in/acet/mock-test): Mathematics and Statistics sections only (1 full mock + 2 sectionals, 20Q/20 marks/50 min), covering algebra, calculus, permutations and combinations, probability, distributions, and correlation, all independently verifiable by calculation. Data Interpretation, English, and Logical Reasoning are not yet built (a coverage gap, not a content-risk exclusion, since every official ACET section is calculation- or language-based)
- [SAT](https://takemocktest.com/in/sat/mock-test): Digital SAT, Reading and Writing (1 full mock + 4 sectionals, 54Q/54 marks/64 min across Craft and Structure, Information and Ideas, Standard English Conventions, Expression of Ideas) and Math (1 full mock + 4 sectionals, 44Q/44 marks/70 min across Algebra, Advanced Math, Problem-Solving and Data Analysis, Geometry and Trigonometry, with a mix of multiple-choice and typed numeric-entry questions). Full coverage of both official sections, since the real Digital SAT already uses 4-option multiple choice (plus a few numeric-entry Math questions) for everything; no task types are excluded. Modeled as a fixed, non-adaptive form rather than the official two-module adaptive delivery
- [GRE](https://takemocktest.com/in/gre/mock-test): Quantitative Reasoning only (1 full mock + 2 sectionals, 20Q/20 marks/35 min), covering the Quantitative Comparison (always the same 4 fixed answer choices) and Numeric Entry question formats from the official measure. Short by design: the real GRE Quant measure itself is only 27 questions in 47 minutes. The official 5-choice select-one and select-one-or-more multiple-choice formats, and Data Interpretation sets, are not included. Verbal Reasoning and Analytical Writing are not covered
- [ACT](https://takemocktest.com/in/act/mock-test): Enhanced ACT (2026), all four sections, each a TakeMockTest-defined shorter practice set on the same 4-option multiple-choice format the official 2026 redesign uses throughout: English (1 full mock + 2 sectionals, 25Q/18 min across Usage and Mechanics and Rhetorical Skills; official is 50Q/35 min), Math (1 full mock + 3 sectionals, 24Q/27 min across Pre-Algebra and Elementary Algebra, Intermediate Algebra and Coordinate Geometry, and Plane Geometry and Trigonometry; official is 45Q/50 min), Reading (1 full mock + 4 sectionals, 18Q/20 min across Literary Narrative, Social Science, Humanities, and Natural Science; official is 36Q/40 min), and Science (1 full mock + 3 sectionals, 18Q/18 min across Data Representation, Research Summaries, and Conflicting Viewpoints; official is 40Q/40 min and optional). Every section discloses its official item count next to the shorter practice count
- [CA Foundation](https://takemocktest.com/in/ca-foundation/mock-test): Paper 3 (Quantitative Aptitude) only (1 full mock + 3 sectionals, 30Q/30 marks/36 min across Business Mathematics, Logical Reasoning, and Statistics, matching the official 40:20:40 mark split with 0.25 negative marking per wrong answer). Official Paper 3 is 100Q/100 marks/2 hours. Paper 4 (Business Economics) is not covered since it leans on economics facts rather than pure calculation. Papers 1 and 2 (Accounting, Business Laws) are not covered since ICAI sets those as subjective, descriptive-answer papers, not multiple choice
- [CMA Foundation](https://takemocktest.com/in/cma-foundation/mock-test): Paper 3 (Fundamentals of Business Mathematics and Statistics) only (1 full mock + 2 sectionals, 30Q/30 marks/36 min across Business Mathematics and Statistics, matching the official 40:60 weightage, no negative marking). Official Paper 3 is 50Q/100 marks/1 hour. Paper 1 (Business Laws and Business Communication), Paper 2 (Financial and Cost Accounting), and Paper 4 (Business Economics and Management) are not covered since they lean on legal, accounting-standard, economics, or management facts rather than pure calculation
- [NDA](https://takemocktest.com/in/nda/mock-test): Mathematics (1 full mock + 3 sectionals, 18Q/45 marks/23 min across Algebra and Trigonometry, Calculus and Vectors, and Geometry/Statistics/Probability, one-third negative marking) and the English portion of the General Ability Test (1 full mock + 2 sectionals, 12Q/48 marks/12 min across Grammar and Usage and Vocabulary and Comprehension, one-third negative marking). Official Mathematics is 120Q/300 marks/2.5hr; official GAT is 150Q/600 marks/2.5hr split English (50Q/200 marks) and General Knowledge (100Q/400 marks). General Knowledge is not covered, since it depends on Physics, Chemistry, General Science, History, Geography, and Current Events facts that carry higher correctness risk for self-authored content
- [CDS](https://takemocktest.com/in/cds/mock-test): Elementary Mathematics (1 full mock + 3 sectionals, 18Q/18 marks/22 min across Arithmetic, Algebra and Trigonometry, and Geometry and Mensuration, one-third negative marking) and English (1 full mock + 2 sectionals, 12Q/12 marks/12 min across Grammar and Usage and Vocabulary and Comprehension, one-third negative marking). Official Elementary Mathematics is 100Q/100 marks/2hr; official English is 120Q/100 marks/2hr. General Knowledge (a separate 100-mark paper) is not covered, since it depends on facts that carry higher correctness risk for self-authored content
- [AFCAT](https://takemocktest.com/in/afcat/mock-test): Verbal Ability, Numerical Ability, and Reasoning and Military Aptitude (1 full mock + 3 sectionals, 24Q/72 marks/29 min, 8 questions per section, +3/-1 marking matching the official scheme). Official AFCAT is 100Q/300 marks/2hr across four equally weighted sections (75 marks each), including General Awareness, which is not covered here since it depends on general-knowledge facts that carry higher correctness risk for self-authored content. The Military Aptitude portion covered is spatial and direction-sense reasoning, not military factual knowledge
- [Territorial Army](https://takemocktest.com/in/territorial-army/mock-test): Reasoning and English (1 full mock + 2 sectionals, 21Q/21 marks/25 min, 12 Reasoning + 9 English, one-third negative marking matching the official scheme). Official Territorial Army written exam is 100Q/100 marks/2hr split Reasoning (40Q/40 marks), General Knowledge (30Q/30 marks), and English (30Q/30 marks); no Mathematics section in the current cycle. General Knowledge is not covered here since it depends on current-affairs and general-knowledge facts that carry higher correctness risk for self-authored content
- [INET](https://takemocktest.com/in/inet/mock-test): English and Reasoning and Numerical Ability (1 full mock + 2 sectionals, 24Q/96 marks/29 min, 12 questions per section, +4/-1 marking matching the official scheme). Official INET is 100Q/400 marks/2hr across four equal sections (25Q/100 marks each): English, Reasoning and Numerical Ability, General Science and Mathematical Aptitude, and General Knowledge. General Science and Mathematical Aptitude is not covered since the Navy bundles calculation-safe Mathematical Aptitude together with General Science facts as one official section with no published internal split; General Knowledge is excluded outright as content-risk
- [Agniveer Vayu](https://takemocktest.com/in/agniveer-vayu/mock-test): English and Mathematics (1 full mock + 2 sectionals, 27Q/27 marks/23 min, 12 English + 15 Mathematics, one-quarter negative marking matching the official scheme). Official Agniveer Vayu (both-streams configuration) is 100Q/100 marks/85 min across English (20Q), Physics (25Q), Mathematics (25Q), and Reasoning and General Awareness or RAGA (30Q). Physics is not covered since it depends on scientific facts and formulas that carry higher correctness risk for self-authored content; RAGA is excluded outright since the Air Force bundles logic-based Reasoning together with General Awareness facts as one official section with no published internal split
- [Navy SSR](https://takemocktest.com/in/navy-ssr/mock-test): English and Mathematics (1 full mock + 2 sectionals, 24Q/24 marks/14 min, 12 questions per section, one-quarter negative marking matching the official scheme). Official Indian Navy Agniveer SSR is 100Q/100 marks/60 min across four equal sections (25Q/25 marks each): Science, Mathematics, English, and General Knowledge. Science and General Knowledge are not covered since both depend on facts that carry higher correctness risk for self-authored content. Scoped to the SSR track specifically; the separate MR (Matric Recruit) track is not covered
- [CLAT](https://takemocktest.com/in/clat/mock-test): English Language, Legal Reasoning, Logical Reasoning, and Quantitative Techniques (1 full mock + 4 sectionals, 30Q/30 marks/30 min, 8 English + 10 Legal Reasoning + 8 Logical Reasoning + 4 Quantitative Techniques, one-quarter negative marking matching the official scheme). Official CLAT UG is 120Q/120 marks/2hr across five sections: English Language (24Q), Current Affairs and General Knowledge (28Q), Legal Reasoning (30Q), Logical Reasoning (26Q), and Quantitative Techniques (12Q). Every Legal Reasoning question here states its own legal principle and facts, answerable from the passage alone with no prior legal knowledge required, matching the official CLAT format. Current Affairs and General Knowledge is not covered, since it depends on facts that carry higher correctness risk for self-authored content
- [AILET](https://takemocktest.com/in/ailet/mock-test): English and Logical Reasoning (1 full mock + 2 sectionals, 24Q/24 marks/19 min, 10 English + 14 Logical Reasoning, one-quarter negative marking matching the official scheme). Official AILET UG is 150Q/150 marks/2hr across three sections: English Language (50Q), Logical Reasoning (70Q), and Current Affairs and General Knowledge (30Q). Current Affairs and General Knowledge is not covered, since it depends on facts that carry higher correctness risk for self-authored content
- [SLAT](https://takemocktest.com/in/slat/mock-test): Logical Reasoning, Legal Reasoning, Analytical Reasoning, and Reading Comprehension (1 full mock + 4 sectionals, 24Q/24 marks/24 min, 6 questions per section, no negative marking matching the official scheme). Official SLAT is 60Q/60 marks/60 min across five equal sections of 12Q each: Logical Reasoning, Legal Reasoning, Analytical Reasoning, Reading Comprehension, and General Knowledge. Legal Reasoning questions here state their own principle and facts, matching SLAT's own stated design that the section tests logical deduction rather than memorised law. General Knowledge is not covered, since it depends on facts that carry higher correctness risk for self-authored content
- [MH CET Law](https://takemocktest.com/in/mh-cet-law/mock-test): Legal Aptitude and Legal Reasoning, Logical and Analytical Reasoning, English Language, and Mathematics Aptitude (1 full mock + 4 sectionals, 24Q/24 marks/24 min, 8+8+6+2, no negative marking matching the official scheme). Official MH CET Law (5-Year LLB) is 120Q/120 marks/2hr across five sections: Legal Aptitude and Legal Reasoning (32Q), General Knowledge and Current Affairs (24Q), Logical and Analytical Reasoning (32Q), English Language (24Q), and Mathematics Aptitude (8Q). Legal Aptitude and Legal Reasoning questions here state their own principle and facts, matching the official syllabus description that the section tests application of legal propositions to facts. General Knowledge and Current Affairs is not covered, since it depends on facts that carry higher correctness risk for self-authored content
- [MH CET Law (3-Year LLB)](https://takemocktest.com/in/mh-cet-law-3-year/mock-test): Legal Aptitude and Legal Reasoning, Logical and Analytical Reasoning, and English (1 full mock + 3 sectionals, 22Q/22 marks/22 min, 6+6+10, no negative marking matching the official scheme). Official MH CET Law (3-Year LLB) is 120Q/120 marks/2hr across four sections: Legal Aptitude and Legal Reasoning (24Q), Logical and Analytical Reasoning (24Q), General Knowledge and Current Affairs (32Q), and English (40Q), with no Mathematics section, unlike the 5-Year LLB pattern. Legal Aptitude and Legal Reasoning questions here state their own principle and facts, the same self-contained format used across every Law exam on this site. General Knowledge and Current Affairs is not covered, since it depends on facts that carry higher correctness risk for self-authored content
- [CAT](https://takemocktest.com/in/cat/mock-test): Verbal Ability and Reading Comprehension, Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning, and Quantitative Aptitude (1 full mock + 3 sectionals, 34Q/102 marks/60 min, 12+11+11, three separately timed 20-minute sectional locks, +3/-1 for MCQs and +3/no-penalty for Type In The Answer numeric-entry questions, matching the official scheme). The IIMs do not publish a fixed official CAT pattern in advance; based on the most recently conducted exam, CAT 2025, the official test is 68Q/204 marks/120 min across the same three sections (24+22+22), with the same three 40-minute sectional locks. All three sections are skill-based (verbal reasoning, data interpretation, logical puzzles, calculation), not fact-recall, so no section needed excluding for content-risk reasons
- [CMAT](https://takemocktest.com/in/cmat/mock-test): Quantitative Techniques and Data Interpretation, Logical Reasoning, and Language Comprehension (1 full mock + 3 sectionals, 60Q/240 marks/108 min, 20 questions per section, single composite timer with no sectional lock, +4/-1 marking matching the official scheme). Official CMAT (conducted by NTA) is 100Q/400 marks/180 min across five equal 20-question sections: Quantitative Techniques and Data Interpretation, Logical Reasoning, Language Comprehension, General Awareness, and Innovation and Entrepreneurship. General Awareness is not covered, since it depends on facts that carry higher correctness risk for self-authored content. Innovation and Entrepreneurship is also not covered, since its official syllabus tests definitional and conceptual business-terminology recall rather than reasoning applied to a stated scenario
- [NMAT](https://takemocktest.com/in/nmat/mock-test): Language Skills, Logical Reasoning, and Quantitative Skills (1 full mock + 3 sectionals, 36Q/108 marks/45 min, 12 questions per section, three separately timed 10/15/20-minute sectional locks, +3/no negative marking matching the official scheme). Official NMAT by GMAC is 108Q/324 marks/120 min across the same three equal 36-question sections, with the same three sectional locks scaled up to 28/40/52 minutes and no time carryover between sections. The official exam also lets candidates choose the order of the three sections before starting; this mock always uses a fixed order, since the engine does not support a pre-test section-order choice. All three sections are skill-based (vocabulary and comprehension, logical puzzles, calculation), not fact-recall, so no section needed excluding for content-risk reasons
- [SNAP](https://takemocktest.com/in/snap/mock-test): General English, Analytical and Logical Reasoning, and Quantitative, Data Interpretation and Data Sufficiency (1 full mock + 3 sectionals, 60Q/60 marks/60 min, 15+25+20, single composite timer with no sectional lock, +1/-0.25 marking matching the official scheme). This mock matches the official SNAP (conducted by Symbiosis International, Deemed University) pattern exactly: same 60 questions, same three sections, same single composite timer, same marking scheme. SNAP dropped its separate General Knowledge and Current Affairs section in 2020 and has not reinstated one since, so no section needed excluding for content-risk reasons
- [ATMA](https://takemocktest.com/in/atma/mock-test): Analytical Reasoning Skills I and II, Verbal Skills I and II, and Quantitative Skills I and II (1 full mock + 6 sectionals, 60Q/60 marks/60 min, 10 questions per section, six separately timed 10-minute sectional locks, +1/-0.25 marking matching the official scheme). Official ATMA (conducted by AIMS) is 180Q/180 marks/3hr across the same six equal 30-question sections, with the same six sectional locks scaled up to 30 minutes each and no carryover between sections. All six sections are skill-based (logical reasoning, vocabulary and comprehension, calculation), not fact-recall, so no section needed excluding for content-risk reasons
- [IBSAT](https://takemocktest.com/in/ibsat/mock-test): Verbal Ability, Reading Comprehension, Quantitative Aptitude, and Data Adequacy and Data Interpretation (1 full mock + 4 sectionals, 70Q/70 marks/60 min, 25+15+15+15, single composite timer with no sectional lock, +1/no negative marking matching the official scheme). Official IBSAT (conducted by ICFAI Foundation for Higher Education) is 140Q/140 marks/120 min across the same four sections (50+30+30+30), with the same single composite timer and no negative marking. This mock is built at exact half scale of the official paper. All four sections are skill-based (vocabulary, grammar, reading comprehension, quantitative reasoning, data sufficiency and interpretation), not fact-recall, so no section needed excluding for content-risk reasons
- [MAT](https://takemocktest.com/in/mat/mock-test): Language Comprehension, Intelligence and Critical Reasoning, Mathematical Skills, and Data Analysis and Sufficiency (1 full mock + 4 sectionals, 40Q/40 marks/32 min, 10 questions per section, single composite timer with no sectional lock, +1/-0.25 marking matching the official scheme). Official MAT (conducted by AIMA) is 150Q/150 marks/120 min across five equal 30-question sections, with the same single composite timer and same +1/-0.25 marking. Economic and Business Environment is not covered, since its official syllabus tests business and economics fact recall rather than reasoning applied to a stated scenario; the other four sections are skill-based (vocabulary and comprehension, logical puzzles, calculation, data logic), not fact-recall, so no other section needed excluding
- [MICAT](https://takemocktest.com/in/micat/mock-test): Verbal Ability, Quantitative Ability and Data Interpretation, and Divergent and Convergent Thinking (1 full mock + 3 sectionals, 60Q/60 marks/60 min, 20 questions per section, single composite timer with no sectional lock, +1/-0.25 marking matching the official scheme). Official MICAT (conducted by MICA, Ahmedabad) has three sections: Section A is a Psychometric Test (150 questions, qualifying only, no scored right or wrong answer), Section B is a Descriptive Test (4 subjective essay questions), and Section C is an Aptitude Test with 80 questions for 80 marks in 80 minutes across four equal 20-question sub-sections (Verbal Ability, Quantitative Ability and Data Interpretation, General Awareness, Divergent and Convergent Thinking). Sections A and B have no auto-gradable answer and are not covered. Within Section C, General Awareness is not covered, since its official syllabus tests current-affairs and business fact recall rather than reasoning applied to a stated scenario, the same content-risk boundary applied to MAT's Economic and Business Environment section
- [TANCET MBA](https://takemocktest.com/in/tancet-mba/mock-test): Business Situations, Reading Comprehension, Quantitative Aptitude, Data Sufficiency, and General English (1 full mock + 5 sectionals, 100Q/100 marks/120 min, 20 questions per section, single composite timer with no sectional lock, +1/-0.25 marking matching the official scheme). This mock matches the official TANCET MBA (conducted by Anna University) pattern exactly: same 100 questions, same five sections, same single composite timer, same marking scheme. Business Situations tests analytical judgment and decision-making applied to a described business scenario or case, not memorized business facts, so all five sections are skill-based and no section needed excluding for content-risk reasons
- [KMAT Karnataka](https://takemocktest.com/in/kmat-karnataka/mock-test): Language Comprehension, Mathematical Skills, and Basic Aptitude (1 full mock + 3 sectionals, 120Q/120 marks/120 min, 40 questions per section, single composite timer with no sectional lock, +1/no negative marking matching the official scheme). This mock matches the official KMAT Karnataka (conducted by the Karnataka Private Post Graduate Colleges Association) pattern exactly: same 120 questions, same three sections, same single composite timer, same marking scheme. All three sections are skill-based (grammar, vocabulary, and reading comprehension; arithmetic and quantitative calculation; logical and abstract reasoning), not fact-recall, so no section needed excluding for content-risk reasons
- [JIPMAT](https://takemocktest.com/in/jipmat/mock-test): Quantitative Aptitude, Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning, and Verbal Ability and Reading Comprehension (1 full mock + 3 sectionals, 45Q/180 marks/69 min, 15 questions per section, single composite timer with no sectional lock, +4/-1 marking matching the official scheme). Official JIPMAT (conducted by NTA for IIM Bodh Gaya and IIM Jammu) is 100Q/400 marks/150 min across three sections (QA 33Q, DILR 33Q, VARC 34Q); this mock covers all three at roughly half scale (15 per section). All three sections are skill-based (quantitative calculation, data interpretation and logical puzzles, vocabulary and reading comprehension), not fact-recall, so no section needed excluding for content-risk reasons
- [MCAT](https://takemocktest.com/in/mcat/mock-test): Critical Analysis and Reasoning Skills (CARS) only (1 full mock + 2 sectionals, 24Q/40 min across Humanities and Social Sciences passages; official CARS is 53Q/90 min across 9 passages). CARS is the only MCAT section that requires no outside subject knowledge, since every answer is verifiable directly from the passage; the other three MCAT sections (Biological and Biochemical Foundations of Living Systems, Chemical and Physical Foundations of Biological Systems, and Psychological, Social, and Biological Foundations of Behavior) are not covered, since they require rigorously fact-checked science content this site is not self-authoring
- [AMU B.Tech.](https://takemocktest.com/in/amu-btech/mock-test): Aligarh Muslim University B.Tech. Admission Test 2026-27, 1 Full Mock (100Q/100 marks/120 min, single combined timer, Chemistry/Physics/Mathematics, +1 for a correct answer and -0.25 for an incorrect answer). AMU's official Guide to Admissions confirms the 100-question/100-mark/120-minute total and the three subjects, but does not publish a per-subject question split; the 34/33/33 Chemistry/Physics/Mathematics split used here is a TakeMockTest pacing structure, not an AMU-published breakdown
- [Assam CEE](https://takemocktest.com/in/assam-cee/mock-test): Assam Combined Entrance Examination (CEE) 2026, conducted by Assam Science and Technology University for B.Tech admission to colleges of Assam, 1 Full Mock (120Q/480 marks/180 min, single combined timer, Mathematics 40, Physics 40, Chemistry 40, +4 for a correct answer and -1 for an incorrect answer, an unanswered or multiply-marked question scores zero). Matches the official ASTU CEE-2026 brochure exactly on question count, marks, duration, subject split, and scoring. The official exam is delivered as an OMR paper in English and Assamese; this mock is presented in English only, a TakeMockTest platform choice, not an official format
- [BITS HD](https://takemocktest.com/in/bits-hd/mock-test): BITS Higher Degree 2026-27, M.E. Computer Science test pathway only (one of several BITS HD disciplines), 2 Full Mocks (100Q/300 marks/150 min each, +3 for a correct answer and -1 for an incorrect answer). BITS Pilani officially conducts Test I (30Q/45 min: Core Mathematics 15, English Language Skills & Logical Reasoning 15) and Computer Science Test II (70Q/105 min) as two separate papers; this site combines both into one attempt with two locked timing windows and no time-borrowing, rather than one free 150-minute clock
- [CG PET](https://takemocktest.com/in/cg-pet/mock-test): Chhattisgarh Pre Engineering Test 2026, conducted by CG Vyapam for B.Tech admission to engineering colleges in Chhattisgarh, 1 Full Mock (150Q/150 marks/180 min, single combined timer, Physics 50, Chemistry 50, Mathematics 50, +1 for a correct answer, no negative marking). The 150-question total and 50/50/50 subject split are confirmed against the current CG Vyapam PET26 exam page; the 180-minute duration and no-negative-marking rule are corroborated across current secondary sources rather than machine-read directly from the official instructions PDF
- [BCECE](https://takemocktest.com/in/bcece/mock-test): BCECE 2026 PCM engineering vacant-seat route (not the primary first-year Bihar Government B.Tech admission route, which runs through UGEAC using JEE Main 2026), 1 Full Mock (300Q/1200 marks/270 min, Physics 100, Chemistry 100, Mathematics 100, +4 for a correct answer and -1 for an incorrect answer). Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics are each separately timed 90-minute papers on exam day; this mock preserves three separate locked 90-minute working windows with no time-borrowing rather than one free 270-minute clock. The exact subject split, per-subject timing, and scoring are corroborated across current secondary sources rather than independently machine-verified from an official document
- [CUSAT CAT](https://takemocktest.com/in/cusat-cat/mock-test): CUSAT CAT 2026 B.Tech, Test Code 101 only (not CUSAT's separate B.Tech Marine Engineering or lateral-entry B.Tech admission tests), 1 Full Mock (225Q/900 marks/180 min, Mathematics 90, Physics 75, Chemistry 60, +4 for a correct answer and -1 for an incorrect answer). One unrestricted timer with free navigation across all three subjects; no subject locking or timing groups, matching the current CUSAT prospectus's single 3-hour paper
- [GATE](https://takemocktest.com/in/gate/mock-test): GATE 2026 Computer Science and Information Technology (CS) only (one of many GATE papers), 2 Full Mocks (65Q/100 marks/180 min each: General Aptitude 10Q/15 marks, plus a 55-question CS paper worth 85 marks split Engineering Mathematics 13/Core CS 72). Mixed question-level scoring in the same test: MCQ (1-mark correct +1/wrong -1/3, 2-mark correct +2/wrong -2/3), MSQ (multi-select, full credit only for selecting the exact correct set, zero credit for an incomplete or wrong subset, no negative marking, no partial credit), and NAT (typed numerical answer, no negative marking). One unrestricted timer with free navigation between General Aptitude and the CS paper; no subject locking. The official GATE 2026 CBT provides an on-screen virtual scientific calculator; this platform does not currently reproduce it, and all questions are written to be solvable without one
- [GUJCET](https://takemocktest.com/in/gujcet/mock-test): GUJCET 2026 Engineering (PCM), 1 Full Mock (120Q/120 marks/180 min, Physics 40, Chemistry 40, Mathematics 40, +1 correct/-0.25 wrong) plus a Physics + Chemistry Paper Practice test (80Q/120 min) and a Mathematics Paper Practice test (40Q/60 min). The Full Mock uses two locked timing windows: Physics and Chemistry share the first 120 minutes with free navigation between the two and auto-submit as a group, then Mathematics gets a separate 60 minutes with no return to the first group
- [JAIN JET](https://takemocktest.com/in/jain-jet/mock-test): JAIN Entrance Test (B.Tech), 1 Full Mock (150Q/150 marks/150 min across six sections: Physics 30, Chemistry 30, Mathematics 30, Aptitude 15, Logical Reasoning 15, English 30, +1 correct, no negative marking). One unrestricted timer with free navigation across all six sections; no subject locking
- [SAEEE](https://takemocktest.com/in/saeee/mock-test): Sathyabama All India Entrance Examination, B.E./B.Tech PCM route, 1 Full Mock (60Q/60 marks/60 min, Mathematics 20, Physics 20, Chemistry 20, +1 correct, no negative marking). - [SITEEE](https://takemocktest.com/in/siteee/mock-test): SIT Engineering Entrance Exam (Symbiosis Institute of Technology), 1 Full Mock (60Q/120 marks/60 min, Physics 15, Chemistry 15, Mathematics 30, +2 correct, no negative marking). One unrestricted timer with free navigation across all three subjects; the four-option format is a TakeMockTest platform representation, since official material does not separately publish a fixed option count
- [OJEE](https://takemocktest.com/in/ojee/mock-test): 2nd/Special OJEE 2026 B.Tech, a later vacant-seat entrance for Odisha B.Tech admission, not the regular first-year route (which uses JEE Main 2026). 1 Full Mock (60Q/240 marks/60 min, Physics 20, Chemistry 20, Mathematics 20, +4 correct/-1 wrong, one unrestricted timer, no subject locking) plus 3 subject sectionals (20Q/80 marks/20 min each, platform-defined timers, distinct questions from the Full Mock)
- [UPESEAT](https://takemocktest.com/in/upeseat/mock-test): UPES Engineering Aptitude Test, B.Tech PCM route, 1 Full Mock (125Q/125 marks/120 min, Mathematics 35, Physics 35, Chemistry 35, English Language Comprehension 20, +1 correct, no negative marking, one unrestricted timer). The 125Q/120min structure is confirmed on the current UPES page; the no-negative-marking rule traces to a prior official candidate guide, corroborated but not independently re-confirmed on the current page
